en: "H-how rude! I am a priest, after all!?{w}Just look at this smile, brimming with loving kindness!"{w}
"That smile is what's creepy!"{w}
"Ngh...!{w}W-well, let's set my face aside.{w}I'd like to hire you, but I think it'll be difficult."{w}
"Huh, why? How come?"{w}
"You're a Skunk Girl, aren't you?"{w}{p}"This is a church.{w}If you went poot-poot all over the place, it would be unbearable..."{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'Skunk Girl' (monster race name; not in glossary). [JP] = fart sound, kept childish as 'poot-poot'.

en: "I don't go poot-poot!{w}It's just that when I get all worked up, I can't hold it in!!"{w}{p}"And Analis is trying so hard...{w}Waaaaah!"{w}
note: Analis refers to self by name; where the source names her I kept 'Analis', where the subject is dropped I restored 'I'.

en: "Ah, hey! Don't cry, please don't cry!{w}Hmm, what should I do..."{w}
"I'll try my very, very best, so please, Mister Priest!"{w}
note: [JP] (childish hiragana) -> 'Mister Priest' throughout to keep the kid voice.

en: "...Then here's what we'll do.{w}Either way, a thief has stolen our bell, so business has dried up right now."{w}{p}"So please go and get the bell back.{w}If you do, I'll hire you here."{w}
"Thank you! You're so nice, Mister Priest!!"{w}
"I'm asking all of you as well.{w}By the way, our only clue is this hand towel the thief left behind."{w}
"Let me sniff it!"{w}
"Isn't that dirty?{w}Well, I don't mind, but..."{w}
"Sniff, sniff...{w}The smell goes straight south!{w}Wait for us, Mister Priest!"{w}
note: [JP]: 'wait for us' since the party is sent with Analis (2770); could be 'me'.

en: Analis left.{w}
"Will that really be all right, I wonder?{w}I'm counting on all of you, too."{w}
note: [JP]: subject left open (Analis or the plan); rendered 'that' to avoid a pronoun for Analis.

en: "Please do get it back.{w}There's no use in me just going through the motions of ringing a bell like this."{w}
note: Repeat-visit line: the priest mimes ringing the missing bell.

en: "Mister Priest, we got the bell back!"{w}
note: Subject dropped; 'we' = Analis and the party.

en: "What, really!?{w}Oh, thank goodness! Now I can get back to work!"{w}
The bell was back in the priest's hands.{w}
"S-so, um, Mister Priest!"{w}
"Yes, yes, it's about the job, isn't it?{w}All right, I'll hire you.{w}Do your best, starting today."{w}
"Really? Yaaay!!"{w}
"Thank you, Mister Priest!{w}Analis is so happy... so happy...{w}Wh-whoa!?"{w}
"What's wrong?"{w}
"Eeek!?"{w}
"Ugh...!?{w}Fugoeeeh!?{w}I-it stiiiiiinks!?"{w}
"Waaah, I'm sorryyy!"{w}
"Mwoooaaagh!?{w}This is... bad, I'm going to di...{w}*Cough!* Gehoooooagh!?"{w}
"A-are you okay, Mister Priest!?{w}Analis will rub your back for y..."{w}
"Gyaoooooooooogh!!{w}D-don't come near me, you skunk bastard!"{w}
note: [JP]: rude insult, kept at strength as 'skunk bastard' ([JP] here is an insult, not a gender marker).

en: "Aww, that's mean, Mister Priest!{w}Analis is sad~{w}So sad that... eeek!!"{w}

"Y-you damn braaaaat!!{w}The window, the windoooow! Oh... pagoooh!?
Gonnupoooh... bleeeaaaargh!!"{w}
note: Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "Eeeyaaah!!"{w}
"You're fired."{w}
"No fair! I want a job!"{w}
"Please, Mister Priest!{w}Analis has nowhere else to go...{w}I'll do anything, so please let me stay here."{w}
"...Honestly, good grief.{w}Be careful, all right!?"{w}{p}"It would be a shame if someone's long-awaited wedding got ruined, wouldn't it?"{w}
"Mister Priest, you're so nice!{w}Thank you! Analis will try really hard!"{w}
"And now...{w}Madrie Church is open for business again!!"{w}
"Yaaay!"{w}
"This is the marriage agency run by Madrie Church! We support the forbidden love between adventurers and monsters!"{w}
"Give Analis three offerings, and Analis will make it a lovely wedding!"{w}
note: [JP] (tip money wrapped in paper) -> 'offerings'; the mechanic is three items handed over (2875).

en: "Right now, if you get married, you might just be blessed with a child!"{w}
"Hooray!"{w}
"Oh, wait. Have you all come from Bistel?"{w}{p}"The Bistel Training Hall is full right now, so it seems no child can be born unless someone gives up their registration."{w}
note: Accuracy: oh-tto is the priest catching himself (he just promised a child, then notices the Training Hall is full): 'Oh my.' -> 'Oh, wait.'

en: "I can still do just the wedding for you. But if you want a baby, make some room at the Training Hall, okay?"{w}
"Is there a monster you've fallen for? Come on, come on! Don't be shy, go ahead and confess!"{w}
"Let's go smoochy-smooch, lovey-dovey!"{w}
Smoochy-smooch lovey-dovey?
note: Choice prompt (26 chars): proceed to the wedding?

en: "Oh my? I don't see your monster partner. You can't get married unless you summon them."{w}
"You can't get married all by yourself..."{w}
"I see, how wonderful! And who will be the partner of this monster here?"{w}
"Ba-dump... ba-dump... so exciting..."{w}
Who will get married?
"Marriiiied! Understood!{w}Then, to make this wonderful day even better!"{w}
note: [JP] = drawn-out 'Married'; matches the later [JP] 'Briiide' (2877).

en: "Even betteeer!"{w}
note: Analis echoes the priest's last words ([JP]).

en: "Off-er-ings! Come on! Off-er-ings!"{w}
"Off-er-iiings~"{w}
Offerings, lovey-dovey?
note: Choice prompt (23 chars): hand over three offerings?

en: "Nooo! We can't hold the ceremony like that!"{w}
"Without offerings, I can't get things ready. Sorry, you two."{w}

Select three items.
(Items handed over will be lost.){w}
note: Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "Briiiide! Splendid! Now, let us prepare the ceremony!!"{w}
"Okaaay! Wait for us, you two!"{w}

note: Kept the source's line-per-name layout with \n; English needs 4 lines on this page -- check it is not split awkwardly in-game. Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "These two first met as enemies.{w}They traded blows, hurled spells at each other,{w}reviled and scorned each other, in days of bloodshed and wounds."{w}{p}"But in the name of their contract they chose to join hands, and have walked together until this very day."{w}{p}"And now, the two shall take their vows."{w}
note: [JP] = the monster contract (party monsters are bound by contract).

en:
"Adventurer {10:0003:000F}.
You now wed this monster, and in defiance of the laws of God, seek to become a married couple."{w}{p}"In health and in sickness,{w}in confusion, in paralysis, in petrification,{w}whether you behead or are beheaded,"{w}{p}"do you promise to love, honor, comfort and help this monster,{w}and for as long as you live, to remain steadfastly faithful?"{w}
note: [JP] rendered 'married couple' / 'spouses' (party member and monster genders unknown, so no 'husband/wife'). Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: Do you take the vow?

"Ooo-MEN!?
Wh-what did you just say...?"{w}
note: [JP]: priest's catchphrase pattern (Married/Bride/No) twisted from 'Amen' into 'Omen' on refusal. Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "You're stopping? You're stopping the wedding?"{w}
"Well, um... I mean...{w}You can call it off, yes, but..."{w}

"Nooooo...
V-very well.{w}It's a pity, but we shall halt the ceremony."{w}
note: Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "Right, you were joking, weren't you! Honestly, don't startle me like that!"{w}
"That scared me~ Phew. Something almost came out!"{w}
note: Fart joke: Analis nearly let one go from the shock.

en: "Now then, let us start afresh... *ahem*"{w}

"Monster {10:0001:0007}.
You now wed this adventurer, and in defiance of the laws of darkness, seek to become a married couple."{w}{p}"In health and in sickness,{w}whether cursed by light or condemned by darkness,{w}whether Good, Evil or Neutral turn their blades on you,"{w}{p}"do you promise to love, honor, comfort and help this adventurer,{w}and for as long as you live, to remain steadfastly faithful?"{w}
note: [JP]/[JP]/[JP] = the alignments Good/Evil/Neutral. Accuracy: literal backslash-n replaced by a real line break (the codec only maps a real newline to 1B 0D; a literal one would print as text).

en: "You have now promised to become spouses.{w}May you keep this vow for the rest of your lives, and build a happy, healthy home."{w}
"Congratulations, you two! Be happy forever and ever!!"{w}
